title: Task Manifest
description: Thin machine-state manifest for an issue-tracker ticket. The tracker is the source of truth for status, scope, and progress (comments = session handoff); this file maps the ticket to repos/branches for the task scripts.

status.description: LOCAL CACHE of the issue-tracker status (concrete mapping documented in CLAUDE.local.md). The tracker wins on conflict; update both together.

notes.description: Offline fallback only. Session handoff lives in tracker comments; scope/checklists in the ticket description.
